title: Observation determined by core data
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean string of length $n$, and let $c,d$ be configurations of $M$ on input $x$. If their core data together with their output summaries are equal, then their Boolean observations agree at every encoded bit position.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
the core data and output summaries of $c,d$ are equal
